correctness.rationale: For full type-A braid normal fan in H, outward normal-cone extremal rays are centered indicators of final permutation segments. Strict inward illumination is precisely positivity of all proper prefix sums of the corresponding permutation of a sumzero u. For generic u, cyclic rotations of any permutation contain exactly one rotation beginning after the unique minimum of cyclic partial sums, hence exactly (n-1)! of n! vertex orders lit. Nongeneric strict illuminated vertices survive generic perturbation, giving <=(n-1)!. Directions ne_i-1 illuminate exactly permutations with first label i and partition all n! vertices, giving ordinary upper n; double-count of vertex fractional constraints gives lower n. Valid for all n>=2 and every polytope with exactly the full fan. Independent permutation enumeration n2..7 corroborated the exact partition but is not relied upon for infinity.
